pattern.description: The camera pushes into the chat thread toward a new empty bubble; the chat bubbles fly out of frame and the bubble grows into an Embed code card whose title, instruction and snippet fade in, with the agent orb huge at the left edge.
pattern.why_premium: One continuous push-in turns a chat bubble into the next UI surface, so the scene change reads as a zoom into the product rather than a cut; the oversized orb keeps brand continuity and adds depth.
